name: FlashBlade - nightly DR drill
description: Every night at 03:00 run the DR drill job template (on each replication peer, promote the replica of the file system, read it, demote it again) and raise an incident when any drill failed; otherwise log a one-line summary. A schedule missed while the orchestrator was down is skipped, not caught up.

nodes.name: Notify: a DR plan has stopped working

extra_vars.subject: DR drill: ${dr_drill.artifacts.failed_count} drill(s) failed
extra_vars.detail: A peer had no replica link for the file system, the replica was not a demoted copy, or the promotion or the demotion did not complete in time. Each drill's dr_drill record in the alert log names the peer, the file system and the error. AAP job: ${dr_drill.job_url}

extra_vars.subject: DR drill: every configured drill promoted, read and demoted its replica on the peer
